package postgres

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

func TestMapPgErrorMapsPGXV5ConstraintViolations(t *testing.T) {
	for _, code := range []string{pgErrUniqueViolation, pgErrForeignKeyViolation} {
		t.Run(code, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := mapPgError(&pgconn.PgError{Code: code})
			if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
				t.Fatalf("expected PostgreSQL %s to map to conflict, got %v", code, err)
			}
		})
	}
}
